description: Darrington Park is a modern strip center built in 2015, offering clean and affordable commercial space for small businesses in the heart of Horizon City, Texas. Strategically positioned just south of the Horizon intersection at 287 South Darrington Road, this 9,600 square foot development features six individual units designed to accommodate medical clinics, professional offices, service businesses, and small restaurants. The center benefits from exceptional visibility with 327 feet of frontage along Darrington Road, a vital connecting artery to Interstate 10 that serves the growing Lower Valley communities of Clint, San Elizario, and Fabens. With over 15,000 vehicles passing daily and prominent neighbors including Walmart Supercenter and major fast food franchises, Darrington Park offers small business owners the perfect combination of high traffic exposure and flexible, affordable lease terms. The property features 48 parking spaces on 2.50 acres and includes monument signage, making it an ideal location for entrepreneurs looking to establish their presence in one of Horizon City's most dynamic commercial corridors.
